entities.name: Dralnu
entities.description: An undead necromancer and lich from Urborg who aided the Coalition forces before betraying them.

entities.name: Lich lady
entities.description: The unnamed Urborgan necromancer who reanimated Dralnu, whom he later killed.

entities.name: Vhelnish
entities.description: A city Dralnu converted into a working city.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Region where Dralnu was a hidden power.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Forces that Dralnu allied with against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: Metathran figure infected by Dralnu with a plague.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The war during which Dralnu allied with the metathran.

events.summary: Dralnu falls in battle and is reanimated as a zombie by an Urborgan necromancer.
events.quote: he fell in battle and was reanimated by an unknown Urborgan necromancer

events.summary: Dralnu kills his master and takes control of her undead legions and Vhelnish.
events.quote: Then he killed his master and took control of her undead legions.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion Dralnu allies with the metathran and helps them advance toward the Stronghold.
events.quote: Dralnu allied with the metathran forces on Urborg

events.summary: Dralnu infects Agnate with a plague during an alliance ritual to seize the metathran army.
events.quote: he also infected Agnate with a plague to take control of the metathran army

events.summary: Grizzlegom exposes the betrayal; Dralnu accuses Grizzlegom of killing Agnate.
events.quote: Commander Grizzlegom realized this and revealed Dralnu's betrayal to the metathran generals.

events.summary: Dralnu is judged guilty and executed; his phylacteries and minions are destroyed.
events.quote: Dralnu was deemed guilty of the murder and was executed.
